title: [Synthetic stress test] Launch incident — English + Hindi, six speakers
reference_status: Assistant-authored synthetic demonstration; not native-speaker validated

people.name: Asha
people.style: Adult woman project manager, natural Indian English and Hindi. Firm, clear, conversational. Never read the delivery instructions aloud.

people.name: Daniel
people.style: Adult male engineer, natural British English accent, tense and defensive. Conversational, not theatrical.

people.name: Hina
people.style: Adult woman operations engineer, fluent Hindi with natural English code-switching, fast but understandable, frustrated.

people.name: Marco
people.style: Adult male quality engineer speaking fluent English with a noticeable Italian accent. Precise, insistent, slightly gravelly.

people.name: Leah
people.style: Adult woman customer lead speaking fluent English with a natural Nigerian accent. Urgent, expressive, professionally frustrated.

people.name: Nikhil
people.style: Adult male security engineer, fluent Hindi and Indian English. Measured low register, becomes emphatic when interrupted.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Okay, everyone, this is a synthetic incident exercise. Six people are on this call. We need one clear decision about tonight's release.

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: The client has already announced eight o'clock. Their support team is getting calls. Please do not tell me we have discovered another blocker.

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: The patch passed on staging. I said the duplicate charge was fixed in the new build, not that production was already safe.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: नहीं, staging और production का configuration अलग है। वही पुराना retry चालू है। मैंने सुबह channel में लिखा था।

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: Exactly. I still have two receipts for one order. Passing a test is not the same as fixing the customer's charge.

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: That receipt is from the old worker! Marco, please check the build number before you say my patch does not work.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: मेरी बात सुनो! Old worker अभी भी चल रहा है। मैं उसी की बात कर रही हूँ। पहले उसे बंद करो!

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Stop. One at a time. Hina, your connection dropped after old worker. Is that worker still accepting real customer jobs?

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: हाँ, अभी भी। तीन पुराने workers हैं। मैंने कहा था तीन, तेरह नहीं। अभी traffic उन्हीं पर जा रहा है।

turns.speaker: nikhil
turns.text: Before anyone restarts them, do not paste the access token into this call's chat. The credential in the screenshot needs rotating.

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: We are losing the client's trust while everyone argues about screenshots. Can we roll back and send a clear message?

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: Rolling back the application will not undo the jobs already queued. That is exactly why I asked for a pause first.

turns.speaker: nikhil
turns.text: और token rotate करना अलग काम है। Rollback से exposed credential अपने आप सुरक्षित नहीं हो जाएगा।

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: We are pausing checkout now. We are not deleting the queue. Daniel, isolate the three old workers and preserve the job IDs.

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: Yes. I will isolate those three workers by eighteen thirty. I need the failed job export before I touch the retry settings.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: मैं export भेजूँगी। पाँच मिनट दो। लेकिन checkout pause की permission Asha दे रही है, मैं अपनी तरफ़ से नहीं कर रही।

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: I need the original job identifiers. A filtered spreadsheet is useless if it hides the duplicates we are trying to find.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: Filtered नहीं है! मैंने सिर्फ़ customer emails हटा दिए हैं। Job IDs और timestamps सब उसी में हैं।

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: Good, remove the personal details. The client needs an incident count, not another file full of customer addresses.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Use the redacted export, retain every job ID. Hina owns that export and the checkout pause. Read that back, please.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: ठीक है। मैं checkout pause करूँगी और redacted export भेजूँगी। Deadline अठारह बीस है। Emails हटेंगे, job IDs नहीं।

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: I counted forty-six affected orders, but that includes retries that failed before charging. We must not call all forty-six double charges.

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: You told me sixty-four ten minutes ago. I cannot send the client three different numbers in one afternoon!

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: Forty-six orders to investigate. Sixty-four is the number of events. Orders and events are not the same unit.

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: And only twelve show a second settled charge in the logs I checked. That is provisional, not a final refund list.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: The confirmed statement is forty-six orders under review. Twelve possible duplicate settled charges, still being verified. Sixty-four events is not an order count.

turns.speaker: nikhil
turns.text: मुझे rotation के लिए दस मिनट चाहिए। उससे service थोड़ी देर reconnect करेगी। इसे outage समझकर कोई पुराना token वापस मत लगाना।

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: Wait, do not rotate during the worker drain. If the export fails halfway through, we will be comparing incomplete records.

turns.speaker: nikhil
turns.text: The token is exposed, Daniel. We cannot leave it valid for an hour just because the export is inconvenient.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: Export पूरा है! मैंने link भेज दिया। अब rotation कर सकते हो। सुनाई दे रहा है? पूरा export आ गया है।

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Then rotate now. Nikhil owns credential rotation by eighteen forty. Daniel must confirm that the replacement credential works before draining the last worker.

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: My connection is awful. Did you say we can still launch at eight, or that eight is cancelled? I need that sentence clearly.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Tonight's eight o'clock launch is cancelled. The new target is tomorrow at ten in the morning, conditional on Marco's verification. It is not a promise.

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: Tomorrow at ten may be possible, but I never agreed that a clean test means every customer's money is already corrected.

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: Nor did I. I am verifying that the defect stops recurring. Finance has to approve the refunds separately.

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: Fine, but somebody has to say who is talking to finance. We keep using the word separately to avoid assigning it.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Fair point. Leah, please ask finance for a refund owner. Refund approval is unresolved; do not write that anyone on this call has authorized it.

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: I can ask them by nineteen hundred. I will own the question, not approve payments. Those are two very different responsibilities.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: एक और correction। Emergency machines का खर्च तीन सौ बीस यूरो है। पहले जो दो हज़ार लिखा था, वह पूरा महीने का estimate था।

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: I heard three thousand two hundred. Are we seriously approving that without procurement? Please repeat the number.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: तीन सौ बीस! Three hundred and twenty euros. Not three thousand. मेरी connection की वजह से बात कट रही है।

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: And please do not put a guessed figure in the client message. They do not need our internal machine costs at all.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: The emergency infrastructure limit is three hundred and twenty euros. I approve that ceiling. It is an internal cost, not a customer refund amount.

turns.speaker: nikhil
turns.text: Rotation is complete. I revoked the exposed token and checked the replacement. Daniel, use the new secret reference, never the actual value in chat.

turns.speaker: daniel
turns.text: I have the reference. The old workers are isolated, but one job is still pending. Please do not mark the whole incident resolved yet.

turns.speaker: marco
turns.text: Exactly. My verification deadline is tomorrow at nine thirty. Until I sign off, the new release target remains conditional.

turns.speaker: nikhil
turns.text: हाँ, credential वाला काम पूरा हुआ है। Payment incident पूरा नहीं हुआ। Notes में दोनों को अलग रखना।

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: I will send the client a holding update by nineteen fifteen today. It will say checkout is paused and tomorrow's ten o'clock target is conditional.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Readback: Hina pauses checkout and sends the redacted export by eighteen twenty. Daniel isolates the three old workers by eighteen thirty.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Nikhil has completed token rotation. Marco verifies the fix by nine thirty tomorrow. Leah sends today's client update by nineteen fifteen.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Eight o'clock tonight is cancelled. Tomorrow at ten is conditional. Forty-six orders are under review, twelve possible duplicate charges are unconfirmed.

turns.speaker: hina
turns.text: और तीन सौ बीस यूरो internal खर्च की limit है। Refund approval अभी बाकी है। उसे approved मत लिखना। ठीक है?

turns.speaker: leah
turns.text: Yes. I will ask finance to name a refund owner by nineteen hundred. I am not promising a refund date to the client.

turns.speaker: asha
turns.text: Good. Leave the pending job and refund approval open. We meet again tomorrow at nine forty-five. That ends the exercise.

facts.statement: Tonight's 20:00 launch is cancelled; tomorrow 10:00 is conditional on verification.
Pause checkout and preserve the queue; do not delete it.
Infrastructure spending ceiling is EUR 320, not EUR 2000 or 3200, and is not a refund amount.
46 orders under review; 64 counts events; 12 possible duplicate settled charges remain unconfirmed.
Hina pauses checkout and sends a redacted export retaining job IDs by 18:20.
Daniel isolates three old workers by 18:30.
Nikhil completed exposed-token revocation and replacement credential verification.
Marco verifies the defect fix by 09:30 tomorrow.
Leah sends a client holding update by 19:15 today and asks finance for a refund owner by 19:00.
Refund approval and a pending payment job remain unresolved; nobody on this call approved refunds.
